description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki Samurai Transmission Roller Bearing Set.
Includes All Roller Bearings & Input Shaft Oil Seal / Extension Case Oil Seal
Japanese Standard Bearings Made by FAG / NMK / Suzuki Japan / SKF
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Bearing #3 (see diagram)
Qty 1 – Bearing #20 (see diagram)
Qty 1 – Bearing #22 (see diagram)
Qty 1 – Bearing #27 (see diagram)
Qty 1 – Bearing #29 (see diagram)
Qty 1 – Bearing #30 (see diagram)
Qty 1 – Oil Seal, Extension Case
Qty 1 – Oil Seal, Input Shaft
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1986 – 1995 All Models
